1.consolidated_definition: Pensar en musarañas. Inventar o creerse un infundio. Inventar mentiras o creerse sus propias mentiras.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To indulge in flights of fancy. To invent or believe a fabrication. To fabricate lies or convince oneself of one's own falsehoods.
